newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - CST started as sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CST started as sell.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report it started coverage of Brazil steel slab producer and exporter Siderurgica Tubarao (CST) with a sell recommendation.
-- Analyst Mirela Rappaport said international steel slab prices were expected to rise only seven percent in 1997 and 3.5 percent in 1998 to $263 per tonne, 12 percent below their 1995 peak.
-- She said stock prices would continue to be pressured by stock overhang and low payout to preferred "B" shareholders.
-- CST preferred B shares closed Wednesday at 15.70 reais, up 2.55 percent.
